definitions.explanation: A situation of serious difficulty or suffering, often with no easy way out. Used for financial, personal, or organizational troubles.

examples.japanese: {苦境|くきょう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{立|た}たされる。
examples.english: To be placed in a difficult situation.

examples.japanese: ⟦{会社|かいしゃ}→会社：00607_kaisha⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{経営|けいえい}→経営：02740_keiei⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{苦境|くきょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{乗|の}り{越|こ}えた→乗り越える：04620_norikoeru⟧。
examples.english: The company overcame its financial difficulties.

examples.japanese: ⟦{長引|ながび}く→長引く：14473_nagabiku⟧⟦{不況|ふきょう}→不況：04844_fukyou⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{多|おお}く⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{中小企業|ちゅうしょうきぎょう}→中小企業：24117_chuushoukigyou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{苦境|くきょう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{陥|おちい}っている→陥る：14537_ochiiru⟧。
examples.english: Many small and medium-sized businesses are falling into difficult circumstances due to the prolonged recession.

notes:
A situation of hardship or adversity. Composed of {苦|く} (suffering/hardship) + {境|きょう} (situation/circumstances). Often used in news and business contexts.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {苦境|くきょう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{立|た}つ→立つ：00758_tatsu⟧: to find oneself in a difficult position
- {苦境|くきょう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{立|た}たされる: to be placed in a predicament
- {苦境|くきょう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{陥|おちい}る→陥る：14537_ochiiru⟧: to fall into adversity
- {苦境|くきょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{乗|の}り{越|こ}える→乗り越える：04620_norikoeru⟧: to overcome adversity
- {苦境|くきょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{脱|だっ}する→脱する：28650_dassuru⟧: to escape from a difficult situation
- {苦境|くきょう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{追|お}い{込|こ}まれる→追い込む：06371_oikomu⟧: to be driven into a corner

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{窮地|きゅうち}→窮地：08684_kyuuchi⟧: desperate situation, predicament — more urgent and critical than {苦境|くきょう}
- ⟦{逆境|ぎゃっきょう}→逆境：22285_gyakkyou⟧: adversity — similar meaning but emphasizes unfavorable conditions one must fight against
- ⟦{困難|こんなん}→困難：01410_konnan⟧: difficulty, hardship — more general; can be used as a な-adjective
- ⟦ピンチ→ピンチ：11143_pinchi⟧: pinch, crisis — casual/colloquial equivalent
